newsitem.title: UK: Soymeal prices surge on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal prices surge on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: High protein soymeal prices surged on the UK meals and feeds market on Monday in anticipation of higher Chicago futures.

Hot dry weather in the U.S. soybean growing areas was expected to push futures higher at the opening and resulted in sellers in the UK marking up high protein soymeal ex-mill by as much as eight stg a tonne while store were around four stg higher.
But higher prices forced most buyers out of the market.
"We've all seen weather markets before in Chicago and no-one is getting excited," said one broker.
In the remainder of the market rapemeal ex-mill Hull and Liverpool was one stg down while ex-mill Erith 0ffers were two stg up as were sunflower pellets from the same mill.
